name: slider
title: Slider
description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The aria-label of each slider thumb. Useful for providing an accessible name to the slider

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The `id` of the elements that labels each slider thumb. Useful for providing an accessible name to the slider

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the slider when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the slider.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slider is disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: Function that returns a human readable value for the slider thumb

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the slider. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the slider is invalid

props.name: largeStep
props.description:
The step value of the slider when the `Shift` key is held, or the
`PageUp`/`PageDown` keys are used.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the slider

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the slider

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description:
The minimum permitted steps between multiple thumbs.

`minStepsBetweenThumbs` * `step` should reflect the gap between the thumbs.

- `step: 1` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 10` => gap is `10`
- `step: 10` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 2` => gap is `20`

props.name: name
props.description: The name associated with each slider thumb (when used in a form)

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the slider

props.name: origin
props.description:
The origin of the slider range. The track is filled from the origin
to the thumb for single values.
- "start": Useful when the value represents an absolute value
- "center": Useful when the value represents an offset (relative)
- "end": Useful when the value represents an offset from the end

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slider is read-only

props.name: step
props.description: The step value of the slider

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
The alignment of the slider thumb relative to the track
- `center`: the thumb will extend beyond the bounds of the slider track.
- `contain`: the thumb will be contained within the bounds of the track.

props.name: thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description:
Controls how thumbs behave when they collide during pointer interactions.
- `none` (default): Thumbs cannot move past each other; excess movement is ignored.
- `push`: Thumbs push each other without restoring their previous positions when dragged back.
- `swap`: Thumbs swap places when dragged past each other.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: The slider thumbs dimensions

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the slider

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Function invoked when the slider's focused index changes

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function invoked when the value of the slider changes

events.name: onValueChangeEnd
events.description: Function invoked when the slider value change is done

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="w-64" defaultValue=[33] aria-label=["Value"] max=100 step=1/>
examples.description: A single-thumb slider bounded by `max` and `step`.

examples.title: Range
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="w-64" defaultValue=[25, 75] max=100 step=1 aria-label=["Minimum value","Maximum value"]/>
examples.description: Pass two values in `defaultValue` for a range slider with two thumbs.

examples.title: Multiple Thumbs
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="w-64" defaultValue=[10, 40, 70, 90] max=100 step=1 aria-label=["First value","Second value","Third value","Fourth value"]/>
examples.description: Pass any number of values in `defaultValue` for multiple thumbs.

examples.title: Step
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="w-64" defaultValue=[50] min=0 max=100 step=10 aria-label=["Value"]/>
examples.description: Set `min`, `max`, and `step` to control the value increments.

examples.title: Vertical
examples.source: import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";
value: ${value.join(", ")}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="w-64" defaultValue=[50] disabled aria-label=["Value"]/>
examples.description: A disabled slider is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Slider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/slider/slider.marko";

<Slider class="mx-auto w-full max-w-xs" defaultValue=[75] max=100 step=1 dir="rtl" aria-label=["القيمة"]/>
examples.description: `dir` is a Zag machine prop, so `dir="rtl"` drives the slider's own layout and interaction direction, not just text flow.
